ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell WMI Win32_Product Install MSI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of an MSI file using PowerShell and the WMI Win32_Product class Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-CimMethod\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-ClassName\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Win32\\_Product\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-MethodName\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.msi.*"))
